rules.rationale: This equation expands the named solutionProgram proof term to the exact translated program AST, so it is a macro-style structural definition.
This is the base equation of the recursive decimal digit-sum oracle for a one-digit nonnegative integer.
This is the recursive equation defining decimal digit sum by the last digit and the remaining quotient.
This equation defines the binary-string oracle at the zero base case.
This equation defines positive binary conversion by dispatching to the positive-number recurrence.
This is the base equation for the positive binary conversion of one.
This recurrence defines a positive binary string from the quotient by two and the remainder bit.
This structural helper equation defines appending a zero bit to an oracle string value.
This structural helper equation defines appending a one bit to an oracle string value.
This equation defines the proof helper that observes equality of two string Values.
This equation defines the named per-input proof check by composing program execution with the independent digit-sum and binary oracles.
This is the base equation defining the empty half-open range check as true.
This recurrence defines a range proof term as the current input check conjoined with the remaining half-open range.
